ev.q: Based on the non-fiction book Dopesick: Dealers, Doctors, and the Drug Company that Addicted America
particular praise for the performances of the cast
strong performances from Michael Keaton and Kaitlyn Dever
an empathetic approach to the very real people impacted by the opioid crisis
The narrative takes place across different points in time
concluded on November 17, 2021, after eight episodes
